column1: Finally, note that if vt and ut are zero for all t, the solution to (8.28) would be pt 1⁄4 xt 1⁄4 0 for all t. In this case, the parameter d in the policy rule (8.27) could not be identified. As Cochrane (2007) emphasized, determinacy relies on assumptions about how the central bank would respond to movements of inflation out of equilibrium. Estimated Taylor rules may not reveal how policy would react in circumstances that are not observed.
